hints.title: Evaluate Combined Value
hints.text: Taking stone i gains aliceValues[i] points while denying bobValues[i] points from the opponent.

hints.title: Sort by Sum of Values
hints.text: Sort stones in descending order of (aliceValues[i] + bobValues[i]).

hints.title: Alternate Turns
hints.text: Alice picks stones at even indices (0, 2, 4...) and Bob picks stones at odd indices (1, 3, 5...).
